verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents a llama.cpp inference engine (alongside Apple MLX), downloading local models from Hugging Face, and loading them via `lms load` with GPU-offload and context-length options. However, no item in the pack names GGUF, so support for that format is inferred from the llama.cpp runtime rather than stated. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of GGUF support, documentation of GGUF quantization variants or selection, and hands-on corroboration of loading GGUF files.
